get.sword: Your old sword. It has carried you a long way.
get.key: A little key, warm from someone’s pocket.
get.axe: An axe. Bram’s hands wore the handle smooth.
get.greatAxe: A steel axe, heavy and patient. It can fell any tree.
get.pickaxe: A pickaxe. Good for coaxing stones out of the boulders.
get.scythe: A scythe, for tall grass and new seeds.
get.shovel: A shovel. The bare earth is waiting for a hole.
get.wood: A dry stick. It would make a fine little fire.
get.stone: A smooth stone, cool in the hand.
get.seeds: A few seeds. Tuck them into a dug hole.
get.bucket: A bucket. Fill it at the water, then pour it on a mound.
get.bucketFull: A bucket full of water, sloshing gently.
get.charcoal: A lump of charcoal. A lit torch eats it gladly.
get.iron: A bar of iron. The workbench will know what to do.
get.ore: Iron ore — stone with metal sleeping inside.
get.bloom: An iron bloom, still warm. Hammer it on the altar.
get.furnace: A little furnace. Feed it ore and charcoal.
get.altar: A stone altar, for patient hammering.
get.mushroom: A mushroom, cool and soft from the shade.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The road ends here. So does the war.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Leave it there. It has done enough, and so have you.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You were a knight. You walked into the dark, and you walked back out of it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The evil you were made to fight is gone. There is nothing left in this valley to defeat.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: That is the strange part, isn't it? A sword always knows what it is for. A person has to find out.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Stay a while. The people here have small troubles, and small troubles are where a new life begins.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Help them, one by one. When the last of them is at peace, the garden in the middle of the valley will open.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Z to talk. X to use what you carry. I to open your bag.

guide.speaker: npc
guide.text: No hurry. This valley has never once been in a hurry.

guide.speaker: npc
guide.text: The forager in the western woods. The painter by the garden beds. The old woodsman and the stargazer, up north.

guide.speaker: npc
guide.text: Each of them is waiting for a small kindness. Small is the right size.

gate.speaker: npc
gate.text: Did you hear it? The garden gate has opened.

gate.speaker: npc
gate.text: Go to the middle of the valley. There is a fire there that has been waiting for you a long time.

after.speaker: npc
after.text: You found it, didn't you. Not a purpose, exactly.

after.speaker: npc
after.text: Just a place to sit, and someone to be.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No hurry. This valley has never once been in a hurry.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The forager in the western woods. The painter by the garden beds. The old woodsman and the stargazer, up north.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Each of them is waiting for a small kindness. Small is the right size.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh — hello. Mind the moss, it's older than both of us.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I gather mushrooms. Not to sell. Just to know they are there, growing in the quiet places.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My knees are not what they were. Would you find five of them for me? Little blue caps, low in the shade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take your time. Mushrooms never rush, and they are never late.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Five little caps... and every one of them perfect.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You walked very carefully to find these. I could tell.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thank you, truly. Keep the next one you find. Some things are better shared over a fire.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I came to this valley to paint it, and I keep painting the same grey.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Maybe the colour isn't in my brushes. Maybe it has to be grown.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here — seeds, and a bucket. Drop the seeds into the holes below my easel, then pour water from the pond on each little mound.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Two patches of green. That's all I need to remember what green is.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Look at that. It came up from nothing but dirt and patience.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I think I was trying to paint something I had never watched grow.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thank you. Next time you pass, there will be a little of you in my painting.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Evening, traveller. The nights out here get long, and my woodpile gets short.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My hands shake too much for the axe now. Funny — they never used to.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take it. The dry trees around my hut give good sticks. Four would see me through.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Chop slowly. A tree that stood for a hundred years deserves a little ceremony.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Four good sticks. That's warmth for a week of nights.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'll sit by the fire and think of you. Not as a knight. As the fellow who brought the wood.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thank you, friend. That is the better thing to be remembered for.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Shh. I'm listening to the stars. They're very quiet tonight.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I want to build a little cairn, right here, where the sky is clearest. A place to come back to.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here's a pickaxe. Would you break three stones from the boulders nearby and bring them to me?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Stones are only stars that decided to stay.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Three stones. One for where I came from, one for where I am, one for where I'm going.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Funny. I crossed the whole sky looking for something, and it was a pile of rocks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thank you. Come sit here some night. There's room for two.

opened.speaker: narrator
opened.text: Somewhere in the middle of the valley, an old gate swings open on its own.

opened.speaker: narrator
opened.text: The hedge around the garden lets out a long breath.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The mushroom turns golden. The fire talks to itself, softly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere behind you, the sword stands in the road, and nobody needs it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For the first time in a very long time, you are not on your way anywhere.

credits.speaker: npc
credits.text: Hollis, who knows where the mushrooms grow

credits.speaker: npc
credits.text: Iris, who learned that green is grown

credits.speaker: npc
credits.text: Bram, who keeps the fire fed

credits.speaker: npc
credits.text: Vega, who stacks stones under the stars

credits.speaker: npc
credits.text: and the old wizard, who waited

credits.speaker: narrator
credits.text: thank you for staying a while
